presentation.title: Headless content publishing — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Headless content publishing.
presentation.description: Editors publish through a CMS while an independent delivery frontend consumes a content API. Media uses object storage and a CDN; publishing jobs refresh delivery artifacts.

objects.name: Content editor
objects.description: Authors and previews content through the CMS backoffice.

objects.name: CMS backoffice
objects.description: Manages drafts, permissions, and publication state.

objects.name: Content delivery API
objects.description: Exposes published content for the delivery frontend.

objects.name: Delivery frontend
objects.description: Renders pages from published content. This reference uses runtime API reads plus cache invalidation.

objects.name: Public media CDN
objects.description: Caches published public media and frontend assets.

objects.name: Content database
objects.description: Stores editorial records and publication state.

objects.name: Media storage
objects.description: Holds uploaded images and documents; only approved public objects are delivered by the CDN.

objects.name: Published content cache
objects.description: Caches published API responses and is invalidated after publication.

objects.name: Publishing queue
objects.description: Carries work generated when content is published or withdrawn.

objects.name: Publishing worker
objects.description: Processes publication changes and refreshes cached content and derived artifacts.
